This request for quotations is intended solely for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in Japan, as prescribed by DFARS 252.225-7042. Prime Contractor's outside of Japan must submit documentation that unambigously demonstrates the Offer's compliance with DFARS 252.225-7042 (e.g. proof of incorporation) as part of their quotation.

For more information, please see the formal request for quotations attached.
